description: Rules-based first screen of whether a person is already Maltese or can register, for two family routes: "birth" (a child born in Malta or abroad to a Maltese parent, the 1 August 1989 rule, the father-only rule for 1964-1989 births abroad and the maternal-line Form I) and "marriage" (spouse of a Maltese citizen, 5 years married and living together, widow/widower and separation cases, the prerequisite of registering a foreign marriage in Malta). Returns an outcome (citizen_automatically | likely_eligible | not_yet_eligible | needs_legal_opinion | out_of_scope), the reasons, the form to use, next steps and official sources. A screen, not a legal determination; the decision rests with Aġenzija Komunità Malta.

birth_date.description: Route birth: the child's date of birth, ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

born_in_malta.description: Route birth: true if the child was born in Malta, false if born abroad.

living_together.description: Route marriage: true if the spouses still live together.

maltese_parent.description: Route birth: which parent was a Maltese citizen when the child was born.

marriage_date.description: Route marriage: date of the marriage, ISO YYYY-MM-DD (the 5 years run from this date).

marriage_registered_in_malta.description: Route marriage: true if a marriage celebrated abroad has already been registered at the Malta Public Registry.

parent_citizenship_basis.description: Route birth: how the Maltese parent holds citizenship. "registration_by_descent" means the parent registered as a descendant (Forms K/M), citizenship then does not pass automatically.

route.description: "birth" to check a child's citizenship by birth/descent, "marriage" to check a foreign spouse's eligibility to register.

separated.description: Route marriage: true if the spouses are separated (legally or in fact).

spouse_deceased.description: Route marriage: true if the Maltese spouse has died.

name: check_maltese_citizenship_eligibility

outputSchema.description: Mirabello envelope; tool fields vary; error only on failure.

title: Maltese Citizenship Screener
